library(gt)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

df <-
  tidyr::crossing(x = 0:9, y = 0:9) |>
  mutate(z = ifelse(x == 7 & y == 4, "4/7", "_._")) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = y, values_from = z)

df |>
  gt(rowname_col = "x") |>
  tab_header("Example Superbowl Square") |>
  tab_spanner("Home", everything()) |>
  tab_style(cell_fill("green"), cells_body(columns = "4", rows = x == 7)) |>
  tab_style(cell_text(color = "#FFFFFF", weight = "bold"), cells_body()) |>
  tab_stubhead("Away")

# Utilities ----- # Count the number of final digits observed across games calc_n <- function(df, colname) { df |> mutate(final_digit = .data[[colname]] %% 10) |> count(final_digit) } # Calculate a team's proportion of digits across games (both home and away) team_final_digits <- function(games, team_code) { home_n <- calc_n(filter(games, home_team == team_code), "home_score") away_n <- calc_n(filter(games, away_team == team_code), "away_score") inner_join(home_n, away_n, by = "final_digit") |> transmute(final_digit, n = n.x + n.y) |> mutate(prop = n / sum(n)) } # Analysis ----- games <- read.csv("../data/great-tables/games.csv") |> filter(game_id != "2023_22_SF_KC", season >= 2015) home <- team_final_digits(games, "KC") away <- team_final_digits(games, "SF") joint <- cross_join(home, away) |> mutate(joint = prop.x * prop.y) |> arrange(final_digit.x, final_digit.y) |> select(final_digit = final_digit.x, final_digit.y, joint) |> pivot_wider(names_from = final_digit.y, values_from = joint) |> mutate(across(-final_digit, ~ round(.x * 100, 1))) # Display ----- joint |> gt(rowname_col = "final_digit") |> data_color(domain = c(0, 4), palette = c("red", "grey", "blue")) |> tab_header( "Super Bowl Squares | Final Score Probabilities", "Based on all NFL regular season and playoff games (2015-2023)" ) |> tab_spanner("San Francisco 49ers", everything()) |> tab_stubhead("KC Chiefs") |> tab_source_note( md('Source data: [Lee Sharpe, nflverse](https://github.com/nflverse/nfldata)') )
